patterns.text: I've been meaning to call my grandma, but I keep forgetting.
patterns.zh: 我一直想给奶奶打个电话，可总是忘。
patterns.example: I've been meaning to clean my room all week.
patterns.example_zh: 我一整周都想收拾房间来着。

patterns.text: It took me a whole afternoon to put this desk together.
patterns.zh: 装这张桌子花了我一整个下午。
patterns.example: It took me three tries to pass my driving test.

patterns.text: I'm not really into horror movies.
patterns.example: I'm really into cooking these days.

patterns.text: I can't stand waiting in long lines.
patterns.example: I can't stand it when people talk during a movie.
patterns.example_zh: 我受不了看电影时有人讲话。

patterns.text: I'm thinking about getting a part-time job.
patterns.example: I'm thinking about learning to swim this summer.
patterns.example_zh: 我在考虑今年夏天学游泳。

patterns.text: The thing is, I don't have enough time.
patterns.example: The thing is, my phone is almost dead.
patterns.example_zh: 问题是，我手机快没电了。

patterns.text: I'd rather stay in tonight than go to a crowded bar.
patterns.zh: 今晚我宁愿待在家，也不想去人挤人的酒吧。
patterns.example: I'd rather walk than wait for the bus.
patterns.example_zh: 我宁愿走路，也不想等公交。

patterns.text: It's been ages since I last saw a movie in a theater.
patterns.zh: 我好久没去电影院看电影了。
patterns.example: It's been ages since I played basketball.

patterns.text: I'm used to getting up early now.
patterns.zh: 我现在已经习惯早起了。
patterns.example: I'm used to living on my own.
patterns.example_zh: 我已经习惯一个人住了。

patterns.text: I was about to leave when it started to pour.
patterns.zh: 我正要走，突然下起了大雨。
patterns.example: I was about to text you when you called.
patterns.example_zh: 我正要给你发消息，你就打过来了。

patterns.text: No wonder you're so tired. You stayed up until three.
patterns.zh: 难怪你这么累，你熬到了三点。
patterns.example: No wonder it's so crowded. Everything is half price today.
patterns.example_zh: 难怪人这么多，今天全场半价。

patterns.text: I wish I had more time to read.
patterns.zh: 要是我有更多时间看书就好了。
patterns.example: I wish I could cook like my mom.
patterns.example_zh: 要是我做饭能像我妈那么好就好了。

links.text: For example, I walked to school every day last week.
links.zh: 比如说，我上周每天都走路去学校。
links.example: For example, I stopped drinking bubble tea for a month.
links.example_zh: 比如说，我戒了一个月奶茶。
links.usage: 说完一个想法，马上补一个具体的例子。

links.text: On top of that, the food there is great.
links.zh: 而且，那儿的东西还特别好吃。
links.example: On top of that, it's only ten minutes from my school.
links.example_zh: 而且，离我学校只要十分钟。
links.usage: 已经给了一个理由，再加一个更有分量的。

links.text: That said, I still think it was worth it.
links.zh: 话虽这么说，我还是觉得挺值的。
links.example: That said, I'd pick a different hotel next time.
links.example_zh: 话虽这么说，下次我会换家酒店。
links.usage: 先说了一面，再往回拉一点，让话不那么绝对。

links.text: The main reason is that I want to save some money.
links.zh: 主要是因为我想攒点钱。
links.example: The main reason is that the office is too far from home.
links.example_zh: 主要是因为公司离家太远了。
links.usage: 被问到为什么时，先把最重要的原因摆出来。

links.text: So basically, it was a pretty good day.
links.example: So basically, we just stayed home and played games.
links.example_zh: 总之，我们就待在家打游戏了。
links.usage: 讲了一堆细节之后，用一句话收尾。

links.text: Speaking of food, have you tried that new noodle place?
links.zh: 说到吃的，你去过那家新开的面馆吗？
links.example: Speaking of trips, where are you going this summer?
links.example_zh: 说到旅行，你今年夏天去哪儿？
links.usage: 顺着对方刚提到的东西，自然地接到新话题。

patterns.text: I've been trying to cook more at home.
patterns.zh: 我最近在尽量多在家做饭。

questions.text: What have you been up to lately?
Anything fun planned for the weekend?
questions.zh: 周末有什么好玩的安排吗？

patterns.text: I'm not a picky eater, but I don't eat cilantro.
We usually just order something and eat in the dorm.
patterns.zh: 我们一般点个外卖在宿舍吃。

questions.text: What did you have for lunch today?
Do you cook, or do you mostly eat out?
questions.zh: 你自己做饭，还是主要在外面吃？

questions.text: What's a dish you could eat every day?

patterns.text: I spent most of Saturday just lying around.
patterns.zh: 周六我大部分时间都在躺着。

patterns.text: If the weather's nice, we might go hiking.
patterns.zh: 天气好的话，我们可能去爬山。

questions.text: What did you do last weekend?
Are you more of a stay-at-home person or a go-out person?
questions.zh: 你更喜欢宅家还是出门？

questions.text: What does your perfect lazy day look like?
questions.zh: 你理想中的懒散一天是什么样的？
